title: Round467 first-five Max Damage intervention transfer check
summary: Replacing Round467 policy actions on the first five battle decisions improved its paired score against public Counterplay by 12.30 pp [4.69, 19.73]; against Max Damage the lift was 6.84 pp [0.00, 13.67], still inconclusive. Each screen used 128 held-out team-pair clusters, two repeated side-swapped outcomes per cluster, 512 games per arm, and zero action corrections/timeouts.
method: Raw and hybrid arms used identical held-out team pairs, previews, repeat indices, and side swaps. Paired uncertainty uses 10,000 team-cluster bootstrap resamples. Showdown chance draws are server-side and not identical between arms.
intervention: Use legal Max Damage joint actions for decision indices 0 through 4, then return control to the Round467 masked PPO policy.
interpretation: The intervention transfers from the Round430 policy to Round467 on these two opponents, with clearer evidence against public Counterplay than Max Damage. This is not PPO learning, broad-population robustness, or optimal-play evidence. The win-probability head was not used for action selection.
next_step: Run an independent held-out seed-set confirmation and evaluate additional policy opponents before considering default deployment.
